name: Justia

sources.title: Create your Justia Lawyer Directory profile — free, requires attorney's law-firm email, moderation period
Justia Lawyer Directory FAQ — free full-featured profiles for licensed US attorneys; claim by email/phone/photo
Justia marketing page — free professional attorney profiles; paid Premium/Platinum placements exist

conditions: Free listing exists but requires being a licensed US attorney — the profile must be tied to the attorney's personal law-firm email address, verified in a moderation period
Claim-by-email / claim-by-phone / claim-by-photo verification for existing auto-created profiles
requirements: Only relevant for legal products/services where a licensed US attorney is the profile subject — not a general product launch directory
Each profile must have unique login credentials tied to the attorney's own law firm email; Justia revokes profiles registered under mismatched emails
Marketing managers creating profiles for clients must use a separate documented flow
Paid Premium/Platinum placements exist but are optional upgrades on top of the free full-featured profile
preparation: Attorney name, bar details, law-firm email address (personal @firm domain, not generic)
Photo, bio, education/experience, practice areas, website/blog and social links
Check if a profile already exists — search the directory first and use the 'click here to claim your profile for free' link
workflow: Search lawyers.justia.com for an existing auto-generated profile; if found, click the claim link on the profile page
Otherwise go to https://lawyers.justia.com/new-profile ('Get Listed') and fill out the form
Verify identity via Claim by Email / Phone / Photo as applicable
Complete the profile (photo, bio, practice areas, links)
Pass the moderation period — Justia reviews that the account email corresponds to the attorney's law-firm address
watchFor: Eligibility wall: US-licensed attorneys only — for a SaaS product this destination is only usable if the founder/company identity fits a legal-services listing
Profiles created under non-matching emails get revoked during moderation
No master logins — one credential set per profile
Upsell: Premium/Platinum placements (paid) compete with free listings for visibility
lawyers.justia.com/register returned 403 to automated fetch — use new-profile / the 'Get Listed' link
countsAsLive: The attorney profile page on lawyers.justia.com is publicly reachable and shows completed profile data past the moderation period
unknowns: Whether website links in free profiles are follow or nofollow
Whether non-attorney legal-tech businesses can be listed (appears attorney-only)
